comment: Caring, great, funny teacher. Genuinely cares about students

Dr. Mendez is truly a gem. She is very caring about her students and extremely accommodating with deadlines. Though discussion-heavy, she is very insightful and if you participate a decent amount, you are pretty much guaranteed to do well in the class. Though she has smaller assignments, most of the grade was through essays and presentations.

If you spend some time on papers and studying for tests you can definitely get an A. You have you give like 6 presentations during the semester so you have to talk a lot. Class isn't super interesting but it's not super hard. She is a really nice professor though and will help you with anything!

Dr. Mendez is a very sweet woman and a decent professor. If you respect her, she will respect you. She will help you out if you ask her, and if you show effort in her class she will make more of an effort with you. She is open to suggestions and will speak in English if something is unclear.

Dr. Méndez is a very sweet woman and a decent professor. If you respect her, she will respect you. She will help you out if you ask her, and if you show effort in her class she will make more of an effort with you. She is open to suggestions and will speak in English if something is unclear.

She will give an assignment with unclear expectations and wonder why you don't do what she wanted. The group project does nothing to improve your Spanish skills. She's a rough grader if you are not good Spanish speaker. She is inflexible with office hours and only is available 2 days a week. if those hours are when you have other classes, it sucks.

Senora Mendez is a good and clear and effective Spanish teacher. She makes sure you know the basics, has a proper amount of homework to supplement what you're learning in class, and is always willing to meet and help out. Tests and quizzes are straight forward, she never tries to trick you. Definitely a solid teacher!

I actually really liked Dr. Mendez for FYS - she is very nice and always attentive to what you are saying in class! Lots of reading every night, but only one final paper. I wish all of the graded assignments weren't all due towards the end of the semester though, it made things somewhat stressful.

Worst professor I have ever had. Assigns useless busy work, and most of her students are smarter than she is. Attendance is mandatory and pointless. Best hope you don't get on her bad side-- she has no compassion for anyone.

she is the kind of professor that gives u a test and makes u wander whats the test on, because u dont get to learn much in her class. very easy, to the point that makes u not want to study for class. heavy on participation. do not recommend unless u want to waste half a year not improving ur spanish

This class was very easy due to her clarity and straightforwardness on tests. She does not try to "trick" you on tests and genuinely wants to do well in the class. I don't think my spanish has really improved that much, but she is very nice and I would recommend her if you want a pretty easy A in the class.
I LOVE LOVE LOVE HER! She has a good sense of humor and that makes you pay attention, thus making a good grade Learned a lot in her class! Great profesora:-)

Class isn't too hard. Test and quizzes are all written. If you put in the study time to make sure you know your stuff it is, for the most part, easy and you will do well. Nice teacher. Get to re-submit compositions after she corrects them. Chance for major extra credit at the end of the semester. Overall good teacher.
Very nice and understanding, but course requires a lot of time.  lots of quizzes but they are relatively easy if you put the time in to study.
She is a genuinely sweet teacher, and understanding. Not challenging on the whole, but you get out of it what you put in it. Good teacher though.
